target.title: fix: skip volatile backup cache paths
target.body:
Fixes #98865

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `openclaw backup create` could still traverse disposable agent runtime caches, browser cache/resource-cache trees, retired archive copies, and common state-side transient sidecars. Those paths can bloat archives or race with tar even though they have no restoration value.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing backup archive path already centralizes volatile filtering through `isVolatileBackupPath`, so this extends that owner boundary instead of adding another archive-time special case. The browser rule is intentionally scoped to cache-like directories under managed `user-data` paths so durable profile files such as `Preferences` and `Login Data` remain eligible for backup.

Issue #98865 was closed manually rather than by a merged runtime fix. I checked current `upstream/main` at `4e6933c84f`, the issue closure events, and related PR search; I found a docs-only open PR (#99007) but no equivalent runtime fix on main.

## User Impact

Backups now skip more disposable runtime/cache files and retired archive copies, reducing archive size and avoiding avoidable live-file races while preserving durable OpenClaw state and browser profile data.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/backup-volatile-filter.test.ts`  
  Result: passed, 51 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/backup-create.test.ts -- --testNamePattern "surfaces the volatile skip count in the summary"`  
  Result: passed, 1 test, 38 skipped.
- `git diff --check`  
  Result: passed.
- `corepack pnpm docs:list`  
  Result: passed and listed `docs/cli/backup.md`.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/infra/backup-volatile-filter.ts src/infra/backup-volatile-filter.test.ts src/infra/backup-create.ts src/infra/backup-create.test.ts docs/cli/backup.md`  
  Result: passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`  
  Result: exited 0 with no actionable output.

Proof gap: I attempted to run the heavier archive integration test path, but on this Windows host it failed during temp-state cleanup with `EBUSY: resource busy or locked, unlink ...\state\state\openclaw.sqlite`. That failure occurred after test execution in the existing SQLite cleanup path, not as a failed volatile-filter assertion, so this PR keeps the new behavior covered at the centralized filter boundary and the summary assertion.
